review.summary: The memo stays within the authorized review scope and clearly discloses retrieval gaps. Two conclusions exceed its evidence: the geometry assessment and the inference about reuse rights.

findings.title: Distinguish unverified geometry compatibility from demonstrated incompatibility
findings.detail: The memo concludes that the schedules cut across modern states and therefore do not support reconstruction by merging modern ADM1 units. Historical divisions being split between modern states does not establish this: those modern units could still reunite into a historical state. No comparison of historical component areas with modern boundaries is documented. Retain the caution that exact reconstruction is unverified, but either document a specific cross-cutting boundary or qualify the stronger conclusion.
findings.evidence: The geometry section names Adamawa, Bauchi, Kwara and Opobo divisions without documenting their correspondence to modern ADM1 units. The Stage 1 verdict then treats incompatibility as established.

findings.title: Keep unknown reuse rights separate from inferred restrictions
findings.detail: The source tables appropriately record unknown gazette rights, but the scope assessment adds that government gazette scans are 'likely not freely reusable'. No checked licence or legal source supports that probability judgment. The instructions explicitly allow unknown rights and prohibit guessing. Keep the status unknown and identify the rights check still needed.
findings.evidence: The gazette rights rows say no licence was read; line 98 nevertheless infers likely restrictions.

checks_performed: Read AGENTS.md, .github/agents/INSTRUCTIONS.md and the task brief.
Inspected the requested base-to-reviewed-commit diff; changes outside the excluded records are confined to the authorized work folder.
Read the memo, Claude's draft summary and structured work record, and compared the Stage 0/1 assessment with the supplied issue-thread context.

Attempted read-only retrieval of both cited gazette PDFs, the Archivi.ng speech, PolicyVault legislation page, UT map index and Nigerian repository homepage. All six requests failed with DNS resolution errors.
unverified_claims: Gazette transcriptions, decree numbers, dates, schedules and section references could not be independently checked against the PDFs.
The speech quotations, state announcements, boundary-adjustment language and copyright footer could not be independently checked.
Claude's reported retrieval outcomes could not be reproduced because this environment could not resolve the source hosts.
Historical-to-modern boundary correspondence, source reuse rights, and the memo's explicitly unchecked 1987, 1991, 1996 and FCT details remain unverified.
review.recommendation_reason: Qualify or substantiate the geometry conclusion and remove the unsupported rights inference before relying on the memo for Stage 1 decisions. External source verification remains limited by unavailable network access.
